Wrote:
  /o/heatmap-light.svg
  /o/heatmap-dark.svg
  /o/swear-jar.md

To show the heatmap on your GitHub profile:
  1. Open (or create) the public repository named after your GitHub username, github.com/USERNAME/USERNAME. Its README.md is your profile README.
  2. Copy /o/heatmap-light.svg and /o/heatmap-dark.svg into the root of that repository.
  3. Paste the contents of /o/swear-jar.md into the repository's README.md, or rename it to README.md if the repository doesn't have one yet.
  4. Commit and push. To update the heatmap later, rerun swear-jar with the same flags, copy the SVG files over again, and push.
